description:
Pokemon HeartGold & SoulSilver -- registered game name "Pokemon
HGSS" (renamed 2026-08-15 from "Pokemon HeartGold" now that both
versions are equally first-class; see docs/architecture.md's
"SoulSilver support" entry).

v0.2.1.description:
# Major Fix and Implementation

## Added
- **Real badge randomization.** Badges are now tradeable/shufflable AP items instead of a fixed logic milestone.
- **Trainersanity, made real.** 390 real, fillable trainer-battle locations, off by default via the `trainersanity` option.
- **A 4th wild-encounter randomization mode**, `zone_method_mapping`: assigns one consistent replacement species per (zone, encounter method) group.
- **Ho-Oh and Lugia as real, checkable locations.** Only reachable after defeating the Elite Four/Champion, matching vanilla; losing/fleeing never blocks anything.
- **Quality-of-life options**: `fast_text_speed` 1 frame / character and `skip_battle_animations`, live-verified against a real BizHawk session. Both off by default.
- **Reusable TMs** option: a consumed TM reappears in the Bag on the client's next poll. ( 1 sec reset )
- **DeathLink support.**
- **Dexsanity** adapt with Randomizer pokemon encounter
- **Convert trade/friendship evolutions** option: rewrites trade-/friendship-based evolutions into plain level-up evolutions at a configurable level.
- The garbled "???" placeholder name shown when picking up another player's item is now a real, readable message.
- **legendarysanity**

## Changed
- **Renamed the world from "Pokemon HeartGold" to "Pokemon HGSS"** (built file is now `pokemon_hgss.apworld`), reflecting dual HeartGold/SoulSilver support. Patch file extension and settings key are kept unchanged for backward compatibility.
- The starter-choice screen now shows the actually-randomized species' name instead of always showing Chikorita/Cyndaquil/Totodile.
- Randomized starters are now restricted to species with at least one evolution, matching vanilla.

## Fixed
- **Region graph logic bugs** found via real tester spoiler-log feedback: two missing vanilla HM/item gates, and a one-way ledge that wrongly let players climb back up.

## Planned for a future release
- Trainer level matching (blocked on a live battle-state ARM hook this project has no toolchain for)
- Randomized start location + starter kit (same class of blocker)
- Human-readable location display names
- Optional extra-difficulty mode: artificial route/passage blockers beyond the existing HM/badge/item gates

##Updrating
Delete the old pokemon_heartgold.apworld from your custom_worlds folder before installing this one.

Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/SingeKiller/Pok-HeartGold_Apworld/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
v0.2.1.title: V0.2.1 Patch, Major Fix  & Implementation

v0.2.2.description:
**New randomizers**

- randomize_move_categories  shuffles each damaging move's Physical/Special split (engine-honored in Gen IV). Status moves untouched.
- randomize_tm_moves shuffles which move each TM (TM01–92) teaches. HM01–08 always keep their vanilla move so field access (Surf, Cut, etc.) stays logically consistent.
- randomize_type_chart shuffles the type-effectiveness table's resistances/weaknesses/immunities.
- randomize_learnsets  randomizes which move each species learns at each level-up slot (levels stay vanilla).
starting_money set (or random) how much money you start with, 0–5000.

**New start & difficulty options**

- randomize_start_location  skip the New Bark intro and spawn directly in Elm's Lab; the real 3-way starter choice still plays out normally. -starting_town picks which of 10 Johto towns the lab's exit door leads to. Fully logic-integrated: the region graph's actual reachable origin follows your chosen town, not just the ROM-side spawn.
- randomize_menu_unlocks  turn Bag/Trainer Card/Pokédex/Pokégear/Save/Options into real, shufflable AP items instead of always being free.
- johto_only  exclude all of Kanto from the region graph and item pool.
extra_route_blockers  closes a real vanilla shortcut (the Route 46→45 ledge) for extra difficulty.


**Fixed**

 -Starter species with a raw decomp label (Nidoran, Mr. Mime, Ho-Oh, Porygon-Z, and several alternate forms) could crash the starter-selection text patch.
- randomize_menu_unlocks locations could self-complete just from receiving the item, with no real in-game action, and could permanently lose a legitimate check to a race condition.
 - johto_only + sphere_based_trainer_leveling crashed generation.
 - randomize_learnsets could crash generation for players who never enabled it; the ROM write is now conditional and degrades gracefully. - Verified safe on real HeartGold and SoulSilver ROMs.
- A write-guard race and a latent crash path in the exit-rule engine, both found in code review.

**Also included**

- Region graph balance fixes, badge/Trainersanity/Dexsanity/Legendarysanity improvements, and a refreshed default player YAML template  see CHANGELOG.md for the complete history.

v0.2.3.description:
**Fixed**

- The Save button stopped doing anything at all, and Bag/Save/Options would disappear entirely after quitting and relaunching, on a randomize_start_location save. Root cause: the old design spawned the player directly inside Professor Elm's Lab and faked having Bag/Trainer Card/Save/Options by poking a flag directly  but the real save-execution code checks something else entirely, so Save did nothing, and nothing was ever actually saved. 
- Full redesign: the player now wakes up and talks to Mom normally (she grants Bag/Trainer Card/Save/Options for real, exactly like vanilla), and only the player's own front door gets redirected to the Lab afterward.
- Black screen when walking through the door: the redirect only patched the destination map, not the exact entry point within that map. Fixed.
- Walking straight back outside if you held a direction while entering the Lab: the landing spot was literally on top of the exit door. Moved further into the room.

**Removed**

- The individual randomize_bag/randomize_trainer_card/randomize_pokedex/randomize_options_button toggles (added yesterday). A live playtest revealed the game's own Pause Menu can't handle an icon being unavailable while the ones after it (Save, Options) are visible  selecting one icon can end up opening a different one entirely. 

That's a limitation of the game itself, never encountered in vanilla since those icons are always unlocked together. No fix is possible without an ASM hook, which we avoid on principle. All four are once again always granted normally, like before yesterday.

**Added**

- remote_items: when enabled, your own items are never written directly into the ROM  you always receive them from the server, the same way you already receive other players' items. Lets you restart a corrupted save without losing progress, or share a save between multiple people.

v0.2.4.description:
**Pokemon HGSS APWorld**
It fixes bugs that made seeds unwinnable, and rebuilds the progression logic after checking the region graph systematically against the game's own maps.

**Any seed generated with an earlier version must be regenerated.**

**Read this before updating**
Two options are gone and will make generation fail if they are still in a YAML.

- extra_route_blockers existed only to delete one Route 46 to Route 45 connection from the graph. That connection was itself a modeling error, since fixed, so the option no longer did anything. Remove the line.

- lake_of_rage is no longer an available starting town for randomize_start_location. The map has exactly two doors, both on the bank ringed by the water, so a player starting there was stranded without Surf. Pick another town, or set the option to random.

**Critical fixes**
- Items could be lost forever when starting a new game. The client could write to save memory before a save file existed. Starting a new game wiped everything it had written, but its own count of delivered items survived that wipe: anything the server had already sent, start_inventory included, was counted as delivered and never sent again. starting_money had the same defect.

- A single bad memory read could send dozens of checks you never made. Reported by a player whose game froze: on reloading, 52 items went out to other players with no way to take them back. Three independent sanity layers now guard every read before a check can be reported.

- DeathLink fired at the start of battles, at random. The fainted-Pokemon counter is stored encrypted in the save file, and re-encrypted every time any statistic changes. The wild-encounter and trainer-battle counters both change exactly when a battle starts, which scrambled the value: roughly half the time the client read it as a death. The counter is now decrypted before being read.

- Found items showed "???" instead of their name. The game has three separate item-name tables and picks between them by sentence construction; only one of the three was being patched.

- Badges no longer unlocked their field moves. Holding a badge only granted its field move once you had also beaten the matching Gym, which made any seed that placed a badge elsewhere unwinnable. Badge and HM are now independent: holding both is enough. This also fixed a permanent block on the Team Rocket takeover storyline, and a cutscene loop.

**Logic overhaul**
- The region graph was checked against the game's real maps. The result was severe: the logic believed half of Johto was reachable with nothing at all.

- Twenty-three connections that do not exist were removed. All had the same shape: two places joined both by a gatehouse and by a direct link the map does not have, so the gatehouse could always be walked around. None of them opened anything on their own, but each silently cancelled any requirement placed on the building it bypassed. That is exactly how the Secret Potion, the Ilex Forest Cut check and the Cycling Road Bicycle check ended up doing nothing.

- Eleven passages blocked by a character are now modeled. None of them opens with an item, only with a step of the story: Slowpoke Well after Kurt, the Azalea Gym after Proton, the Team Rocket hideout after Lance at the Lake of Rage, the Mahogany Gym once the hideout is cleared, the Blackthorn Gym after the Radio Tower, the Dragon's Den after Clair, and on the Kanto side the Power Plant, Saffron's underground gatehouses, both Snorlax and the Viridian Gym.

- Key items and badges that gated nothing now do. The Rainbow Wing to climb the Bell Tower, the Fog Badge to approach it, the Silver Wing for Lugia, the Basement Key for the Goldenrod Tunnel, the Card Key for the Radio Tower, the Earth Badge for Cerulean Cave, the Volcano Badge for Route 19, and the Bicycle for Cycling Road.

- Kanto was one key item away from the start of the game. The Olivine sailor checks that the game has been cleared before he even looks at your S.S. Ticket: the ferry does not sail until the Elite Four and the Champion are beaten.

- Three areas were modeled as one place when the terrain splits them in two: Route 46 at its ledge, the Lake of Rage across the water, and the Ice Path, whose exit to Blackthorn sits two floors below and needs Strength.

- Dexsanity could lock a key item behind the very Pokemon that item unlocks. A seed became unwinnable that way: the Squirtbottle was placed on the Tropius check, Tropius only appeared in the Burned Tower, and the Burned Tower is inside Ecruteak, which the Squirtbottle itself opens. Two defects made that invisible. Checks existed for Pokemon never written into the patched ROM at all, and a check's requirements only described the tool needed, never the place. Every check now requires actually reaching somewhere that Pokemon lives.

**New options**
- magnet_train (on by default) decides whether the Magnet Train counts for the logic. On, the Pass alone opens the ride and Kanto can be visited early. Off, the ride only counts once you have beaten the Elite Four, so nothing you need can be hidden in Kanto before then.

- balanced, a new mode for randomize_moves. Power and Accuracy are drawn together from weighted tiers instead of independently, so a 200-power move never comes with coin-flip accuracy. Accuracy never drops below 75.

**Behaviour change**
- randomize_start_location no longer touches your front door. The option rewired your house door to lead into Elm's Lab, and that shortcut was permanent: players who came home much later found their own front door still leading into the lab. The opening is vanilla from start to finish again.

**State of this release**
All the logic is covered by a test suite exercised against both real ROMs. Emulator validation is another matter and remains partial: the eleven story locks are correct at source level, checked line by line against the decompilation, but *not all of them have been observed in game.*

Bug reports are welcome, especially on those locks and on seeds using randomize_start_location.
